My Story

About me?

I am currently pursuing a masters at GT since Fall of 2024. I take interest in areas such as Robotics, Computer Vision and AI. I am also serving as a teaching assistant for the course CS3630: Introduction to Perception and Robotics and work at RAIL Lab led by Dr. Sonia Chernova.

Some hobbies I picked up during my undergrad were; playing guitar, do stargazing, solve rubiks puzzles! I have participated in WCA competitions for fun. Check out the blog section for it!
